highlights: Eleven more seed packets now give you a real sowing window — instructions like "early spring when soil is cold" or "1-2 weeks before average last frost" were being ignored completely
Packets the app genuinely cannot read no longer claim "Too late this year" on every date of the season — they now say a sow profile is needed, and show you the packet's own words
Save seed that did not come from one of your plantings — store-bought, a gift, foraged — without having to find a planting first
Changing a seed quantity twice in quick succession no longer lets the older change overwrite the newer one
Android's Back button closes the Save-seed sheet instead of navigating away from the page underneath it
